summary: Backend API regression passed; workspace and account UI flows passed, but add-expense FAB is blocked/hidden behind bottom tabs on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 the Add expense control is rendered underneath/behind the bottom tab bar; tapping testID add-expense does not open the modal, so expense entry cannot proceed.

issues: FAB overlaps the fixed bottom navigation despite bottom: 94; it appears clipped/covered in the mobile viewport.

action_items: Move the add-expense FAB into a reliably visible layer above the tabs (or adjust its containing layout/z-index) and retest the complete expense-to-sync flow.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceProvider sync uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the requested configuration name is EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current environment exposes the PUBLIC variant, but the naming should be made consistent to prevent deployment misconfiguration.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST workspace and transaction via backend test; UI used cleared local storage and TEST-prefixed workspace/account before the blocked expense step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, workspace and account creation pass using modal-save-top. add-expense testID resolves but is behind bottom tabs and modal does not open. Backend root/workspace/sync round-trip passes.
rca_of_issue: The FAB is absolutely positioned inside the ScrollView content hierarchy while the tab bar is a later absolute sibling. On the mobile viewport it is clipped/covered by the tab bar; the click reaches no usable control. Reproduction: clean storage, create workspace and account, tap [data-testid=add-expense].
